# StPageFlip (Nodlik, MIT)

StPageFlip animates the page-turn effect over the canvases produced by PDF.js.
**Not bundled** with the theme — download once and drop into this folder.

## What to drop into this folder

From the official release page:

```
https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip/releases
```

Pick a release such as `v2.0.7`. From the `dist/` directory of the zip, copy:

```
page-flip.browser.js  →  assets/vendor/stpageflip/page-flip.browser.js
```

(Use the `.browser.js` build, not the ES module build.)
